title: Scaling Looped MoE Language Models under Matched Budgets: Information Flow and Parameter Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2611.34276v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Looped Transformers decouple computational depth from parameter count, and prior studies have demonstrated promising performance gains with increased computation. However, systematic design principles for configuring these models under strict iso-parameter and iso-FLOP constraints remain scarce. We contribute to this direction by improving information flow in looped models and systematically studying loop parameter configurations. Specifically, we refine this information flow via gated inner-loop state updates and a cross-stage residual connection. Building on this design, controlled studies identify a configuration combining a single-pass Core depth of 25%-35% of the total unrolled depth with reallocating saved parameters into extra routed experts per layer, improving performance at zero extra compute while preserving compatibility with existing training infrastructure. Evaluated after 1T pre-training tokens, our 69B MLA and 51B KDA Mix

translated_title: 匹配预算下循环MoE语言模型的扩展：信息流与参数分配
translated_abstract: 循环Transformer将计算深度与参数量解耦，先前的研究已经证明通过增加计算可以获得可观的性能提升。然而，在严格的等参数和等FLOP约束下配置这些模型的系统性设计原则仍然稀缺。我们通过改进循环模型中的信息流并系统研究循环参数配置来为这一方向做出贡献。具体而言，我们通过门控内循环状态更新和跨阶段残差连接来优化信息流。基于这一设计，受控研究确定了一种配置方案：将单次传递的Core深度设为总展开深度的25%-35%，并将节省下来的参数重新分配为每层额外的路由专家，从而在零额外计算开销的情况下提升性能，同时保持与现有训练基础设施的兼容性。在1T预训练token后的评估显示，我们的69B MLA和51B KDA Mix（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文通过门控内循环状态更新与跨阶段残差连接改进循环MoE模型的信息流，并在等参数、等FLOP预算下发现将单次Core深度设为总展开深度的25%-35%、同时把节省的参数重新分配给每层额外路由专家的配置，能够以零额外计算成本提升模型性能。
en_tdlr: This paper enhances information flow in looped MoE models via gated inner-loop state updates and a cross-stage residual connection, and shows that under matched parameter and FLOP budgets, a configuration with a 25%-35% single-pass core depth plus reallocated saved parameters as extra routed experts per layer improves performance at zero extra compute.
